# SkillPath

> Neural Career Intelligence: Skill gap analysis and career trajectory mapping.

## Overview
SkillPath is an AI-powered career development platform designed to analyze current skills, uncover critical skill gaps, and map out customized learning paths for target tech roles.

## Core Capabilities & Features
- **Skill Gap Analysis**: Upload resume or input skills to get AI-driven gap identification.
- **Career Trajectory Mapping**: Dynamic roadmap generation based on deep learning market benchmarks.
- **Time Machine**: Simulate career advancement and skill accumulation over time.
- **Role Exploration**: Discover emerging tech roles, market demand, and required competencies.
- **Skill Battles**: Challenge and evaluate interactive skill scenarios.

## Important Pages
- [/](/): Landing page with interactive exploration engine and career intelligence overview.
- [/analyze](/analyze): Skill gap analysis and personalized career roadmap generator.
- [/explore](/explore): Tech role exploration engine and salary benchmarks.
- [/time-machine](/time-machine): Interactive career simulation tool over multi-year horizons.
- [/battle](/battle): Interactive skill evaluation scenarios.
- [/history](/history): Past analyses, saved skill paths, and learning progress.
